annotations.title: Read the yearly tourism series of an Italian comune

description: Reads the yearly series of nights spent (presenze) and arrivals of one Italian comune, split by guests resident in Italy and abroad, over a range of years. Use it for the trend of one comune, given its 6-digit `cod_istat` from cerca_comune; do not use it for one year or for capacity and population (use leggi_dati_comune instead), or for several comuni (use confronta_comuni instead). Rows are yearly, oldest first; from 2025 ISTAT counts include privately rented holiday flats, so `anno_discontinuita` and `nota` flag that totals across 2025 are not comparable (hotel figures are). A comune without figures returns an empty list in `serie` with a `nota`, and a range outside its years with data or an unknown code returns an error that says what to pass. Read-only, public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

a_anno.description: Last year to include, e.g. 2024, not before `da_anno`; default: the latest year with data. A range with no year of data returns an error that gives the years.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune as a string, leading zeros kept ("058091" is Roma); it comes from cerca_comune.

da_anno.description: First year to include, e.g. 2015; default: the first year with data.

name: leggi_serie_comune

anno_discontinuita.description: 2025 when the series reaches it: from 2025 ISTAT counts include privately rented holiday flats, so totals and non-hotel figures are not comparable with years before 2025 (hotel figures are). Null when every row is before 2025.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune, as a string with leading zeros kept.

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

nota.description: Notes in English on reading the series (the change of scope above, a comune without figures, or a range without a year of figures); null otherwise.

provincia.description: Province (or metropolitan city) as recorded by ISTAT; null if not recorded.

regione.description: Region as recorded by ISTAT (Bolzano and Trento are provinces of TRENTINO-ALTO ADIGE); null if not recorded.

scheda.description: Link to the comune's public page on datituristici.it, to cite.

serie.description: One row per year with movement figures, oldest first, from `da_anno` to `a_anno`; yearly figures only. An empty list when the comune has none, or none in that range (`nota` then lists the years that have figures).

arrivi_italiani.description: Arrivals of guests resident in Italy during `anno`; null if not available.

arrivi_stranieri.description: Arrivals of guests resident abroad during `anno`; null if not available.

arrivi_totali.description: Guest arrivals (check-ins) at accommodation establishments during `anno`; null if not available.

presenze_italiani.description: Nights spent by guests resident in Italy during `anno`; null if not available.

presenze_stranieri.description: Nights spent by guests resident abroad during `anno`; null if not available.

presenze_totali.description: Nights spent by all guests in accommodation establishments during `anno` (one guest staying three nights counts three); null if not available.

title: Read the yearly tourism series of an Italian comune
